notes: The published title includes 'S-H-I-T' (spelled-out profanity), so this page is titled Justin Desai LS; the post's title is kept in the source citation as published.
Posted 12 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.
The post says the deck went 3-1 at the RamapoCon III DPC and 3-1 at the RamapoCon III Open (two days at Ramapo).

Starting cards as posted under 'Start(6)': Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can, Dagobah, Heading For The Medical Frigate ('heading for your mom'), Battle Plan ('battle your mom'), Squadron Assignments and 'wise advice or insight'; they count toward the 60. No single starting Effect is named, so starting effect is left empty.

The list as posted has 56 cards. The strategy updates say he forgot Test 1 and Anakin's Podracer ('aniakins racer') and that 2x I Know belong in the deck; those four are added as he says, making 60. 'test 1' dested Great Warrior (Jedi Test #1).
'wise advice or insight' (start) and 'insight or wise advice' (effects) name two possible cards each, so they are kept as posted (Wise Advice or Your Insight Serves You Well).
'4x dagobah sites' and '2x grab your mom(grabers)' do not name the cards, so they are kept as posted.

The author's 'your mom' joke names were dested to the cards they replace: 'heading for your mom' Heading For The Medical Frigate, 'battle your mom' Battle Plan, 'anger fear and your mom' Anger, Fear, Aggression, 'projection of a mutherficker' Projection Of A Skywalker, 'it could be your mom' It Could Be Worse, 'gift from your mom' Gift Of The Mentor, 'qui's mom proder' Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (the deck's only weapon; Qui-Gon's only card of that era).

Posted 'luke skywalker' dested the Premiere Luke Skywalker (the strategy mentions deploying 'farmboy' for Test 1); 'chs' Captain Han Solo; 'epp leia'/'epp luke' Leia With Blaster Rifle / Luke With Lightsaber; 'qui gonn' Qui-Gon Jinn (Tatooine).
